about.title: About Raadiye
about.intro: Raadiye is a platform that helps the Mogadishu community recover lost belongings by connecting the person who found an item with the person who owns it.
about.whatTitle: A simple way for people to get their items back.
about.whatP1: Losing something important can be stressful. Finding something that belongs to someone else can also be hard.
about.whatP2: Raadiye is one place where you can post an item you found, report an item you lost, or search listings that have already been posted.
about.findBody: Search found items or items someone else has lost.
about.returnBody: Help someone get back what they own.
about.communityBody: Connect finder and owner through in-app chat or a phone call.
about.trustBody: Phone numbers stay hidden until someone chooses to make contact. We do not ask for secrets.
about.step1Body: Post an item you found, or an item you lost.
about.step2Body: Search by name, category, or district.
about.step3Body: Reveal the number, call, and confirm it is the right item. Do not exchange money.
about.missionBody: To make recovering belongings simple and open to the community, without sharing private details.
about.closeBody: A small honest action can mean a great deal to someone else.

services.title: Four steps from lost to returned
services.body: Raadiye keeps public details light and private marks secret, so the real owner can be recognized before anyone shares a phone number.
services.foundBrowseBody: Sign up and use the platform immediately. Email is only needed if you forget your password.
services.foundPostBody: Share a title, place, and photo. Add secret marks that only the owner would know. The public never sees them.
services.lostBrowseBody: Look through found and lost listings. Similar items are suggested by name, category, and district.
services.lostPostBody: Describe the marks. If the poster accepts, you can see the number, chat safely, and arrange the return.
services.privacyBody: Never put PIN codes, passport numbers, or extra secrets in the public title. Do not send money. Meet in a public place.
services.ctaBody: Every returned item is different. Join Raadiye and help your neighbors.

home.lookingForBody: Choose a category to search quickly.
home.step1Body: Sign up and start immediately. Email is only used if you need to reset your password.
home.step2Body: Add a public title and place. Keep secret marks private so only the real owner can describe them.
home.step3Body: Browse found and lost listings. Raadiye suggests similar items by name, category, and place.
home.step4Body: The claimant describes the marks. If they match, the poster accepts the claim, then you chat or call and return the item.
home.ctaBody: Sometimes what someone lost seems small, but to the owner it can matter a great deal. Raadiye helps the community help itself.
home.ctaFoundTitle: Did you find something, or lose something?
home.ctaFoundBody: Post it so the other person can call you.

hero.title: Lost something? Let us help you find it.
hero.body: Raadiye connects people who find items with the people who own them. Search for your item, post something you found, or report something you lost.
hero.cardBody: What you are looking for might already be here. One small step can mean a lot to someone else.
hero.directBody: Phone numbers stay private until marks are confirmed.
